name: Fuuun Aiuchi Gakuen Potato
source:
This is an alternate scenario right after "Fuuun Aiuchi Gakuen Flat."  
Our hero, "Sakai Fukashi," still hasn't found a girlfriend.  
As he navigates a lonely school life,  
What kind of encounters await him?  

Heads up! You won’t get it if you haven’t played the previous game!  

[Translated from [url=https://negativegang.uijin.com/poteto.html]the official website[/url]]
